## Accepted boundedness partial, attempt 1/5

Problem 11000150 / AMR-109-0150, rank 1256. For each fixed genus g >= 1, positive factorizations of one boundary twist with pairwise geometric intersection at most one form finitely many simultaneous-conjugacy classes and have a finite attained length maximum. Repetitions are allowed, disk-bounding twists excluded, and all mapping classes preserve orientation and fix the sole boundary pointwise. The broader boundary-parallel convention is retained and analyzed.

The complete report and audit preserve the right-veering positivity argument, exact deletion algebra, self-contained finite-alphabet Higman proof, mod-two support bound, finite ribbon-graph/complement orbit proof and centrality step. The separating-factor exclusion includes the full capped Lefschetz-fibration construction, (-1) section and homologically nonzero fibre needed for the credited Smith theorem. Prior results are explicitly credited, including M(1)=12 and M(2)=40 and generic Higman-based factorization methods.

The arbitrary-length subquestion is answered negatively in fixed genus. The exact maximum for g >= 3, an explicit numerical upper bound and extremizer classifications remain unresolved. No Hurwitz, positive-Artin, T-move or A5/D6 classification is claimed. The distinct-support bound is not a factorization-length bound; no effective exhaustive-search stopping rule is supplied.

## Publication boundary and review limits

Exactly six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000150/`. Full symbolic arguments and mathematical examples are retained. Programs, computational sections/results, fixtures, imported dataset contents, copied third-party source bodies and private coordination material are excluded. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no historical novelty, priority, current-openness certification, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Recorded source retrieval and inspection are historical observations. Edition preparation makes no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature-search claim.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
